details: The ongoing military escalation between the United States and Iran has pushed Brent crude oil prices above $91 per barrel and U.S. national average gasoline prices past $4 per gallon, signaling significant energy market volatility. Despite heightened geopolitical tensions, Bitcoin has demonstrated some resilience, reclaiming the $65,000 mark. However, the broader crypto market has experienced increased volatility with significant liquidations, and investor sentiment remains cautious, marked by 'Extreme Fear'. Washington has also signaled an openness to diplomatic engagement, which could offer an off-ramp from the conflict.
title: US-Iran Conflict Drives Oil Prices Up, Crypto Shows Mixed Signals

details: Russia's State Duma has passed a law officially recognizing major cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), and XRP as legal property. This legislation permits their use in commercial and cross-border transactions. The law, effective September 1, 2026, removes wallet disclosure requirements but maintains oversight by the Bank of Russia. Retail investors will face an annual purchase cap of 300,000 rubles ($3,800), which can be increased to 3 million rubles with a knowledge test.
title: Russia Legalizes Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP for Transactions
